warning_source: State Comptroller Matanyahu Englman / Office of the State Comptroller
recipient: Home Front Command; IDF Operations Directorate; Southern Command; Defense Ministry/NEMA; NSC; broader government system
warning_summary: Official follow-up audit warned that Sderot's evacuation plan remained incomplete, 17 border communities had no designated reception destination, 231650 residents within 40 km of Gaza lacked nearby standard protection, and the national evacuation framework was incomplete or difficult to implement.
evidence_update: Primary 2020 State Comptroller record establishes the warning and institutional recipients. Official 24 Feb 2026 follow-up states some prewar deficiencies had not been corrected in time and that at war outbreak there was no updated approved national evacuation/absorption plan, no authorized national operational plans and no emergency drills. Published to Notion as WARN-128 with High confidence.
gaps: Not an October 7/Hamas assault forecast. Personal Netanyahu receipt of this specific audit chapter is not established; receipt is documented at audited institutional level. Do not infer causation.

recipient: IDF/Home Front/Southern Command/Defense Ministry institutional recipients
warning_summary: Earlier primary audit documented that community-defense units provide initial infiltration response, radio shortages and relay gaps could delay IDF response, and rabashatz/IDF procedures were missing or not followed in some sectors.
evidence_update: Recovered the 2018 primary HTML record: only about 28% of required Orange Lightning radios and 63% of internal radios had been supplied by July 2017; communications gaps could delay force response during infiltration. This evidence was attached to existing WARN-125 rather than published as a duplicate event.
gaps: No separate current-government personal-delivery event established. Keep as predecessor evidence in WARN-125 unless a distinct later re-warning is recovered.

recipient: Political echelon; named recipient/forum still not recovered
warning_summary: Contemporaneous reporting said MI warned that war was closer than calm, deterrence was eroding and adversaries were coordinating across fronts.
evidence_update: Lane 6 documentary recovery did not locate the underlying primary memorandum, exact distribution list or an authoritative record naming the recipient/forum. Existing secondary reporting remains materially unchanged.
gaps: Need primary document or reliable official record of named qualifying recipient before promotion.

recipient: Security system; political/senior decision-maker distribution not established
warning_summary: Shin Bet publicly reported that its investigation found Hamas in Gaza directed a 4 September attempt to move standard C4 explosive and detonators through Kerem Shalom concealed in a clothing shipment.
evidence_update: Official contemporaneous Shin Bet publication establishes the operational fact and Hamas direction. It is a potentially relevant border/security signal but no evidence was recovered that it was framed as a strategic warning or delivered to a named senior political/security decision-maker beyond the investigating system.
gaps: Do not promote unless recipient/distribution evidence or contemporaneous assessment shows it was treated as a broader warning of border vulnerability or impending escalation.
